waves.note: Wave height forecast for the marine gridpoint at ROBN4 (not the land proxy)

wind_forecast.note: Hourly over-water forecast at ROBN4; the anemometer sits at 21 m, so observed runs slightly higher

seas.note: Harbor Entrance buoy — approximate for Upper Bay; typically an upper bound inside the Narrows

met_primary.note: CO-OPS PORTS publishes ~6 min behind observation; the NDBC file for the same station runs ~50 min behind and is the fallback

visibility.note: ASOS proxy; ROBN4 VIS column is permanently MM

tide.note: NOAA published predictions; local harmonic is the fallback and runs ~1 h late (omits V0+u and node factor)

marine_grid.note: NWS marine gridpoint raw data via /points resolution — waveHeight for seas, also reused for humidity/dewpoint (ROBN4 buoy has neither sensor)

current_method.note: No active current prediction or observation station near ROBN4
